notes.title: Bigger changes in Color Defense
notes.notes:
Dear players,
A bigger change in the game is coming and some smaller changes already arrived ingame. 
We had some discussions about a few game systems players don't like and we want to change this.

This will get changed:

Microtransactions
We are deleting all microtransactions from the game. The first part is done 2 days ago and we removed the gems shop from the steam store page. in the next days we will remove all ingame buttons and the premium currency view.

The Login/Account system
Some palyers had problems with the account system or misunderstood how the system works. Because of that we are deleting it. To save player data with will get in 2 parts. 
1. We are saving all previously on the server saved data locally at the player savegame
2. We are deleting the server connection sytsems

Online/Offline Mode
For online server events there wills till be a server connection (without any player data) needed to download if an event is active or not. For players who don't want this will we add an Offline mode (in settings) to stop all server connections completely. For all other players is the online mode available in which they can use the events when they are active.

How do we then get income with the game?
We stillw ant the game to be f2p for all ebcause of that we add 4 optional DLCs which can be bought to support us if you want. They are compeltely optional and not needed to play the game

What happens with my data which is at the moment saved on the server
Some data like the unlocked pets are saved on the server. We are saving them soon after a patch locally in your save game. After a few days we make another patch in which we delte the server connection on this part from the game. The data on the server will then be completely deleted from the server. From this point we do not hold any data from you anymore in any way.

And after this? 
After this changes do we have several updates planned with new maps, new systems and much more.


This all needs a few days and we do it as fast as we can. 

Kind regards SLMEPHI
